## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models resmlp12_224x224
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target resmlp12_224x224_sync   # once
./bin/resmlp12_224x224_sync \
  -m assets/models/resmlp12_224x224.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/resmlp/resmlp12_224x224/resmlp12_224x224_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/resmlp12_224x224.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```
